title: Manager terminals 4: dispatch a pane into any project
notes: Part of the parent card 'Manager terminals: ask the dashboard about any project and dispatch work into it'. dashboard pane claim --project <name|aka> opens the project if it is closed and claims a pane on its page; run/release work on it as today; dashboard pane list --all lists panes across projects. The worker's report goes to the session that dispatched it (the manager's main session when it came from there).

comments.body: PR #158 merged: dashboard pane claim --project <name|aka> opens the project if closed and claims a pane on its page; pane list --all lists panes across open projects; throwaway worktrees are released from the project they belong to.
